“就是这里！快进去！”

魔都繁华的四环内，一处较为偏僻的巷口，不远处的高楼耸立，霓凰灯四射，这里却较为黑暗，一行人手持棍棒，奔跑着进入巷子。

他们来到一个没有门面的小门，一脚踹开，这些人凶神恶煞一般的鱼贯而入。

但见这里云雾缭绕，点着几根香，小小的空间里，没有什么其他装饰，只有一张桌子一副字画。

桌子后面坐着一个道士装扮的年轻人，看到眼前这些人冲进来，怒目而视，手持钢管，于是也是站了起来，喊道：

“喂喂喂，你们要干什么？”

一个脑袋包着纱布的家伙手提钢管，指着那年轻人。

“胡九郎，你这个小赤佬！说自己是从龙虎山天师府下山来的高人，什么都能算，却为什么不给老子算？”

胡九郎上下打量着这个人，缓缓摇了摇头，也不说话，指了指自己身后的那幅字。

这幅字写的歪歪扭扭，不过倒是能看的清清楚楚：

“寿命将尽之人不算、无缘之人不算、不信之人不算！”

“陈天一，不是我不给你算，实在是无从算起呀！”

陈天一怒道：

“你什么意思？谁跟你说老子不信了？”

胡九郎摇了摇头。

“这就不是信不信的事。”

陈天一怔了一下。

“难道老子不是有缘之人？”

胡九郎还是摇了摇头。

陈天一这些反倒是有些呆了，他身后的小弟有人开口道：

“老大，他的意思你是快死掉了……”

陈天一回头呵斥道：

“用你说？老子还能不明白吗？”

陈天一靠近胡九郎，胡九郎并无惧色，不过还是往后退了几步，到达墙壁，直到退无可退。

“小赤佬，上次老子来找你算命，你不给我算，只留下一句没必要算了，结果老子被开了瓢，现在你又跟老子说这些话，说我快死了？我看你真的活的不耐烦了！老子是听说你准才来找你的，你不要敬酒不吃吃罚酒！”

胡九郎微微一笑。

"This is it! Come in!"

Within the bustling Fourth Ring Road of the Magic City, there is a relatively remote alley. Not far away, tall buildings stand tall and neon lights are shining. However, it is relatively dark here. A group of people holding sticks ran into the alley.

They came to a small door without a facade, kicked it open, and these people filed in with ferocious looks.

But I saw that the place was filled with mist, a few incense sticks were lit, and there were no other decorations in the small space, only a table and a pair of calligraphy and paintings.

There was a young man dressed as a Taoist priest sitting behind the table. When he saw these people rushing in, glaring angrily and holding steel pipes, he stood up and shouted:

"Hey hey hey, what are you doing?"

A guy with his head wrapped in gauze was holding a steel pipe and pointing at the young man.

"Hu Jiulang, you little red guy! You said that you are an expert who came down from the Tianshi Mansion in Longhu Mountain. You can calculate everything, but why don't you let me calculate it?"

Hu Jiulang looked this man up and down, shook his head slowly, and pointed to the words behind him without saying anything.

The writing is crooked, but you can see it clearly:

"Those who are about to expire will not be counted, those who have no destiny will not be counted, and those who do not believe will not be counted!"

"Chen Tianyi, it's not that I won't calculate it for you, it's really impossible to calculate it for you!"

Chen Tianyi said angrily:

"What do you mean? Who told you that I don't believe it anymore?"

Hu Jiulang shook his head.

"It's not a matter of belief or not."

Chen Tianyi was startled.

"Isn't I a destined person?"

Hu Jiulang still shook his head.

Chen Tianyi was a little stunned by this. Someone behind him said:

"Boss, he means you are about to die..."

Chen Tian turned around and scolded:

"What do you mean? Can I still not understand?"

As soon as Chen Tian approached Hu Jiulang, Hu Jiulang showed no fear, but he still took a few steps back and reached the wall until he could no longer retreat.

"Little Chi, last time I came to you to tell my fortune, but you didn't tell me, and you just said that there was no need to tell. As a result, I was shot. Now you say these things to me again, saying that I am going to die? I think you are really impatient! I came to you only after I heard that you were sure, so don't give me a toast or drink as a penalty!"

Hu Jiulang smiled slightly.
